reviews.author: Caleb Hamlin
reviews.text: They have always been honest with me. they do great work pretty quickly, ive taken my toyota up there and everytime its been a good experience! Really great people running the business and great mechanics couldn't ask for better!!

reviews.author: Kathleen Vess
reviews.text: They have been taking care of my vehicles for almost 4 years. They've done great work and have been honest and fair. Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: James Umsted
reviews.text: They do a great job at a reasonable cost. I would highly recommend them to anyone who needs mechanical repairs.

reviews.author: Angela WNC
reviews.text: Very professional and accommodating. I had a small somewhat mini emergency and they got me in right away

reviews.author: Brad P
reviews.text: These guys are good at fixing vehicles. Our Ford F150 front drivers side caliper got stuck shut coming down 221 from Spruce Pine. We arrived at Camping World in Marion but noticed a bad smell and smoke coming from behind the front driver side wheel. I called Derek's muffler and automotive repair at 1:45 p.m. on a Saturday. They close at 2:00 on Saturdays, but we're kind enough to fix our truck so we could take our camper home. The mechanic that worked on the caliper and rotor and brake pads on the front driver side was also kind enough to put the two extra pads that came with the other two on the passenger side. All this was done at a reasonable price. They did not raise the price because it was Saturday and they did not raise the price because they worked an hour overtime. I extremely urge you if you ever have problems in the Marion area to go to Derek's muffler and automotive repair! They will do you right and fix it right!

reviews.author: Rudy Degi
reviews.text: Went by there in a hurry needing some help with a possible brake/master cylinder problem. Gave us honest advice and were willing to help as soon as we showed up. We appreciate the honesty, knowledge and integrity. Will recommend to others as we were also recommended by a friend to go there today.

reviews.author: Kayla Stokes
reviews.text: They were fantastic! Got me in and out fairly quickly and had wonderful customer service. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Molly Heintzelman
reviews.text: Derek's did an amazing job with my Chevy cruze! I am not someone who knows a lot about cars and they were very transparent about what needed to be done and they were never condescending in any way which unfortunately is rare in the automotive world. They were willing to be flexible with me while I worked through a few hurdles. I highly recommend them, particularly JR. He did great and was super kind! Thank y'all so much! I will definitely be back when I need more service on my car!

reviews.author: Abraham Sanchez
reviews.text: We were out of town visiting family we have nearby when our car broke down , we called Derek’s and they were able to fit us in next day and got us back on the road the day after they were amazing and really great people I highly recommend taking your business here !

reviews.author: Michelle Casey
reviews.text: Derek's is a good place to take ur vehicle to they r reasonable priced quick friendly folks all around. I brought my vehicle in and they had me in and out under 4 hours for a small issues

reviews.author: Lisa Warren
reviews.text: Derek's Muffler was a blessing today. I am from S.Ga and working in Marion, while leaving work my breaks on my vehicle were bad. They were they ONLY place open on Saturday and got my repairs done in a little over an hour. JR was so professional and caring and did just what he told me he would do. The whole staff was genuinely kind. Thank you for a job well done!

reviews.author: eli ramos
reviews.text: Went in for honest work came out with a motor "issue". Not even your last resort should you bring your car here! This place was my worst experience!!

reviews.author: Bobbie Holley
reviews.text: Derek's Muffler and Auto repair are amazing! Dropped my car off in the morning for brake and roter repair and work was completed in a couple hours! I had another business repair my brakes and roters and in less than two weeks Derek's Shop had to do the work again! I'm so pleased and thankful for the great job Derek's team did! Very professional and great business ethics! I would recommend Derek's shop for all your repair needs!! They will definitely get my business from now on! Thank you guys!!

reviews.author: Alice Kelley
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the job they did for me to replace valve cover gaskets on my SUV. The cost for the job was well within my budget. Everyone from the lady at the front desk right down to the one who shows you what they did very courteous and family oriented. Will go back!! A+ guys

reviews.author: MarkAnita Lipton
reviews.text: Derek's muffler and auto repair were great! Had us a new muffler on in no time and reasonable. We are from out of town and nobody could do it yesterday but they could! Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Marion Moss
reviews.text: These guys were awesome!! We were traveling and had trouble with the brakes on our truck. We had already spent a considerable amount of money getting the brakes fixed only to drive on to Marion and had the same problem. Derrick's Mufer knew exactly the problem, stopped what they were doing and got parts and repaired in about 2hrs for a lot less than we had earlier paid. They know vehicles!!

reviews.author: Tonya Coffey
reviews.text: My husband had his radiator replaced here. When we brought it home, it was leaking transmission fluid and coolant so we took it back. They said they didn't know why it was leaking and couldn't help us. We had to wait several months to be able to afford to have another mechanic look at it. The competent mechanic said the radiator was faulty and the hoses had not even been tightened! Basically it was gross incompetence that the leak was not identified and corrected by Derek's. The new mechanic advised that the faulty radiator should be covered under warranty, but when I requested that Derek's honor the warranty on the part they installed they refused, because they said they didn't warranty other people's work. They installed the radiator and were presented with the opportunity to fix the problem and refused, so we had no choice but to take it to another mechanic. I don't think they even tried to see why it was leaking, because it was ridiculously obvious. Do yourself a favor and use a reputable mechanic, not these guys.We are now out another $740 to fix their mistakes and replace a faulty part out of pocket that should have been covered by the manufacturer's warranty. We also had issues with my car repair around the same time. I will never use this shop again and will tell anyone I know to steer clear of their shoddy work and business practices. Finding a good mechanic can be difficult and we took a chance here and were burned. I'm so glad we found someone else that is honest and capable.

reviews.author: Tracy Hogan
reviews.text: I was camping in Marion and my truck blew out a brake line. These guys helped me on a Saturday. Did a great job on the repair and were very reasonable, did not try to take advantage of me being from out of town. I highly recommend them and would use them again.

reviews.author: Kristan Campos
reviews.text: We had to take our car back three times because they said they fixed it and it kept doing the same thing. They put used parts on it and charged us almost $500. They kept the car there for a week and didn't call or tell us it was ready. The only thing good about them is that they fixed the car for free afterwards. Osmand-i think that's his name- is the best worker they have. He's bilingual and very helpful. I recommend talking to him if you need work done on your car.

reviews.author: Ivan
reviews.text: I got a new engine put in, and Derek made sure that I had a warranty to cover it, so that it would be better protected in the future. His pricing was extremely fair, and allowed me to get an even better motor than previously quoted at another shop, for my car. He has also done exhaust work, which I love, and am extremely happy to show off. He knows exactly what his customers are aiming for, and he does his best to provide that. I would definitely recommend Derek’s Muffler and Auto Repair.

reviews.author: Cody Wiseman
reviews.text: Great people, they know what they are doing, great work, also have a tow truck, and very reasonable prices.

reviews.author: Dante Eudora
reviews.text: Completely misdiagnosed my problem. It was obvious even to me as I pulled my struggling car off the highway that I had a transmission issue. I told them that, they disagreed, said I needed a new alternator and radiator. 800 bucks later and surprise, I got 10 miles down the highway and started having the same problem, engine revving but vehicle not accelerating. Took it to a transmission specialist....what a surprise, I need a new transmission. Don't come to this place, they either don't know what they're doing or intentionally do unnecessary work.

reviews.author: Ivan L.
reviews.text: I'm from Florida and was in Asheville for Thanksgiving week 2020. The heat shield of my exhaust came loose and was rattling. I went to 3 different shops and no one could take my car in the same day since everyone is short-staffed this week. I went to Derek's and they were extra nice and were able to squeeze me in given that I was out of town and had to drive back home . Thank you so much for the help!!

reviews.author: Trey Barrier
reviews.text: Had them work on our Cadillac because it was running hot. We had to have a motor replaced the other was done for. 2 weeks we were driving again. That was 2 weeks to check old motor, pull old one, order new one, and put it in. That's pretty fast in my opinion. Ross is my go to guy, very nice, knowledgeable, and gets the job done. Thank you to all of yuns, we Cadillacing again.

reviews.author: Barbara Smith
reviews.text: My van broke down at my grand daughters VBS. We called around finally got someone to come pick it up. After getting it in the shop the next morning, they told me a list of things that was causing it. So I told them not to mess with it and I brought it to Derek's Muffler where he told me he would find the problem asap. He then contacted me and told me it was the fuel pump. After just fixing that one part, my van was working perfectly again. This is the best shop in Marion, and I will continue to bring my vehicles to this affordable and reliable place.

reviews.author: Ethan Jenkins
reviews.text: BRING YOUR CAR IN FOR REPAIRS HERE This is one of the most efficient and honest auto repair shops around old fort and surrounding areas. Ross is a great mechanic, and will find the fix to any auto related repair. They work on both foreign and domestic vehicles for an affordable price

reviews.author: Chris Byers
reviews.text: Was in a wreck on Thursday which really messed my muffler up and needed it fixed. Went to 4 places on Friday trying to find someone to fix it... none of which had time to fit me in.... however, Derek's Muffler, even tho they were covered up too, was able to help me out. I travel alot for my work and absolutely needed this done so I could run my business and they were able to help me out. So, shout out to these guys here for being understand of my situation and getting back on the road so I could continue business as normal.

reviews.author: David Allison
reviews.text: Just dropped in unannounced needing some exhaust work performed. They were working on it within 30 minutes and fixed more than I was quoted with no upcharge. Upstanding group of people with great prices.

reviews.author: Vernon Ghostwalker Vandegrift
reviews.text: I brought my 85 Camaro up there for some exhaust work,,, being a man of over 30 years experience as an A.S.E. Certified mechanic/custom specialist I shopped around before letting them work on my car,,,, I'm 100% disabled now and no longer have my own shop,,, so I was reluctant getting it done by anyone but myself!!! I just got done building the cars motor and transmission,,, it took me over a year to get everything done since I live on a low fixed income and have a hard time doing the work now,,, but I wanna say that these guys run a family owned business so I was comfortable with the atmosphere there and the staff that worked there,,,Matt had some an excellent job on my exhaust because he took the time to do things right,,, they price was alittle more then wanted to pay but it was well worth the trip,,, I'm very satisfied with his work on my baby!!! THANKS MATT!!! and thanks to the others there at Derek's muffler shop,,,I will definitely recommend them to me friends!!! ***** Five stars guys thanks again,,, sincerely Vernon Vandegrift aka the ghostwalker!!!

reviews.author: Jeffrey Ellington
reviews.text: My experience with this shop was horrible. They were supposed to check 3 things and said it would be ready by Wednesday at the latest. Wednesday comes and they don't even have the parts in. Friday evening, they tell me that one of the items I asked them to check a week before was in worse shape than they thought. No phone calls, no communication at all. I would not recommend this shop to anyone. 3 days later the transmission is leaking again and the mechanics just want to mouth off. Very unprofessional and unreliable.

reviews.author: Luke W
reviews.text: I had a family member with an extremely urgent car emergency and they were very helpful and quick. Fair price as well.

reviews.author: travis kinney
reviews.text: Would not recommend using this place.. Took my truck there and needed a oil cooler gasket replaced they claimed they did so and they wanted to do head gasket and then I received a call claiming my block was cracked picked the truck up and had 3 different mechanics look at it came was told block was not cracked and now I'm stuck putting it back together and I just changed the oil cooler gasket they claimed they replaced and it was no good and now I'm putting head back on

reviews.author: Jessica Scruggs
reviews.text: I took my car to this shop, dropped it off around 4:15 and they said they would look at what’s wrong with it first thing in the morning. I never got a call back so I called around lunch time to see if they looked at it, they said they are in the process of looking at it. Still didn’t get a call back that day so the following day I called at 12. They said the guy looked at my car but was eating and would call me back to tell me what’s wrong with it. Never heard back from them so I just went up there to get my car back and saw my car was parked at the side of the building next to other cars and looked like it was never touched!!! Yeah I’m not going back.

reviews.author: Tim McNeil
reviews.text: The Taj Mahal it ain’t. But if you’re looking for honest, swift, economical service, get your car or truck to Derek’s Muffler! My wife and I broke down high in the Appalachian mountains near Mt. Mitchell on a holiday weekend. These men worked their mechanical magic and got our only vehicle back up and running in short order! The only wait was for parts and that was out of their control. While they’re located over an hour from us, I’d seriously consider using them again! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Daphne Burleson
reviews.text: 5 stars great people! Fair prices just nowhere to park especially if your disabled or it would have been 5 stars all the way Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: Pamela Mackey
reviews.text: We use him anytime our cars need fixing. He has fixed my husband jeep. And fixed my car several times. Does a great job.

reviews.author: Debi Ross
reviews.text: They have worked in our cars for 10+ different problems. They always do great work & are cheaper than any other places. Will not take my cars to anyone else.

reviews.author: Scott Cox
reviews.text: Derek's is a great place for car service. He's honest and prices are fair. I live an hour away and will always see Derek when my truck needs attention.

reviews.author: Melissa Davis
reviews.text: Russ was very helpful to my Mother whom was having a difficult time getting her car repaired. Thank you so much for all your help and going above and beyond. I am grateful!

reviews.author: OTHER-TERRESTRIAL LIFE-FORM
reviews.text: They fixed my brakes quickly and the price was reasonable. Will be coming back to this mechanic for my repair needs

reviews.author: Tara Smith
reviews.text: Great staff.. Fair prices. Taken my car there a few times. Ross and the rest of the staff is awesome

reviews.author: Wilma Brooks
reviews.text: Had some car repairs at reasonable price. He also replaced a faulty part free of charge. I appreciate hard working Americans!!!

reviews.author: Christy Shepard
reviews.text: Great customer service and friendly staff. JR was courteous, efficient, and provided excellent customer service.

reviews.author: zack strouse
reviews.text: Affordability priced, professional, only repair shop I will take my vehicles to. Easily accessible from I40, and they do state inspetions!

reviews.author: Carrie Atkins
reviews.text: Derek's muffler is a great place to get your vehicle fixed and their kindness and Godliness are pleasing to our family.

reviews.author: Lisa Lentz
reviews.text: Best auto repair shop in McDowell County by far! Christian owners ALWAYS do right by their customers.

reviews.author: Jennifer Styles
reviews.text: Mechanic,Ross, who helped me went above and beyond. No wait time was in and out and back to work. Thank you
